Execution & Delivery is the primary theme, with Org & Working-Model Transformation a strong secondary theme.

The recurring difficulty in his transformation engagements was that clients modernized technology while keeping the same silos, handoffs, and bottlenecks. At **Accenture**, teams also needed to shift from traditional IT delivery to product-centric ways of working, but their starting points varied across product management, agile, DevOps, and modern engineering. Clients wanted iterative development and customer-centric products while still working within legacy systems, compliance requirements, and traditional governance.

Matt addressed execution and working-model transformation together. He built the Atlanta and Tampa Cloud Innovation Centers, introduced balanced teams across product, engineering, and design, and adapted Lean XP for enterprise complexity. His teams used pair programming, test-driven development, automated pipelines, and discovery and framing rather than treating modernization as a technology replacement alone.

Talent & Enablement included competency frameworks, targeted training, and “I do, we do, you do” coaching on actual client work. Emerging Tech and Strategic & Advisory included research and startup partnerships, client workshops, and tailored IT strategies. Risk & Responsible Tech included enterprise security scanning, access controls, compliance, and IP and confidentiality concerns. Professional Narrative covers his career arc from Software Engineer to Solution Architect to Director to Cloud Innovation Center Leader.

The CIC grew from **zero to 150+ practitioners**, delivered **30+ product engagements**, and achieved **4X faster velocity** and **zero-defect deployments**. Delivery reputation and client relationships contributed to **\$100M+ in repeatable business**.', error=None, details={'client_count': 1}).checks
